title: WNF SMP 2
description: A Create-focused survival modpack with performance upgrades, quality-of-life improvements, and expanded automation for multiplayer world
body:
WNF SMP 2 is a survival-friendly modpack built around the Create mod and its major add-ons. It expands vanilla gameplay with mechanical automation, factory building, and improved world interaction while staying lightweight and easy to run on small servers.

The pack includes a variety of Create extensions such as Create Addition, Create Ore Excavation, Slice & Dice, Steam Rails, and more, allowing players to design complex machines and transportation systems. Utility mods like JEI, Jade, and Veinminer make resource gathering and crafting more efficient, while performance mods such as FerriteCore, Distant Horizons API, and Entity Culling ensure smooth gameplay even on large builds. Integrated voice chat provides a better multiplayer experience.

Players can expect a gameplay experience focused on automation, exploration, and collaborative building with minimal changes to the core Minecraft feel.
